home.metaTitle: Learn Korean from a song you love
home.title: Know the line. Then say it yourself.
home.subtitle: Bring a song you already love. A tutor helps you turn that lyric into Korean you can use in a drama, on a trip, or with a friend. You talk first, for free, on Ojakgyo. A lesson only happens if you both want it.
home.ctaNote: Ojakgyo is a free chat on the tutor’s page. This site doesn’t charge you yet.
home.pathLead: You can do the first two steps today. The experience pack and the recommended slot are marked because they aren’t for sale yet.
home.step1Body: Bring a song you already sing. That’s where the lesson starts.
home.step2Body: Message the tutor on their page. It’s free, you can open it anytime, and it isn’t sold inside any package.
home.step3Body: If the chat feels right, ask for a first lesson. We don’t take payment on this site yet.
home.step4Body: A short run of lessons after the first one. Not for sale, so there’s no price here.
home.step5Body: A paid spot tutors may buy later, to sit nearer the top. Nobody has paid for today’s order.
home.tutorsLead: You only see profiles we’ve approved. If there are no reviews, the star stays blank.
home.tutorsEmpty: No tutors are public yet. When one is approved, open their page and say hello on Ojakgyo. It’s free, and this site isn’t charging anyone today.
home.tutorsError: The tutor list could not be loaded. Refresh the page in a moment.

faq.a: It’s where learners outside Korea find a tutor and start with a song they already love.
A free chat on a tutor’s page. You can open it anytime, and it isn’t included in any paid product.

faq.q: Does the site charge for a lesson?
faq.a: Not yet. Asking for a first lesson does not charge you here.

faq.q: Are the experience pack and the recommended slot for sale?
faq.a: No. They aren’t for sale, and this site lists no price for them.
See a tutor, say hello free on their page, and ask for a first lesson only if you both want it.

apply.title: Teach students who already love the song
apply.desc: Your students start with lyrics they already know, then want Korean they can use. We only publish a profile after we read it.
apply.who: You’re fine on camera. You can turn a lyric, a chat, or a sound into a real lesson. You can answer an Ojakgyo message within 48 hours.
apply.after: We’ll say yes, ask for a revision, or ask you to wait. If we say yes, you show up in Find Tutors and get a channel.
apply.bioHint: At least four lines. Who you teach, what, and how.
apply.bioPlaceholder: e.g. I fix the sounds that break in idol lyrics. Beginners start with one line, no romanization. Weeknights and weekend afternoons. English ok.
apply.photoHint: JPG, PNG, or WebP. Max 5MB. Emoji-only or scenery will be sent back.
apply.gate: Log in to send an application. We read the intro and photo before anything is published.
apply.success: Got it. We’ll read your intro and get back to you.
